context: Data visualization — a heatmap table showing synthetic test coverage percentages across skills (rows) and test dimensions (columns), with palette and sort controls
first_impression: A clean, functional heatmap table with legible cells and a sensible Blues encoding, but the overall feel is competent developer work rather than deliberate design
what_works: Adaptive text contrast (white on dark cells, dark on light) is a genuine design choice executed correctly; the tooltip is deliberately styled with a dark background and teal accent color rather than a plain browser default
what_doesnt: Browser-default select elements in the controls row undermine the otherwise tidy header and feel unfinished; the 130px rotated column headers consume a large vertical band that dominates the layout, pushing the data down and creating an unbalanced proportion
